cbcmoreshells.ponder.dual_cannon/dual_ca: Dual Cannon Introduction
Dual cannons are used similarly to big cannons. They must be assembled on a cannon mount to function, and require at least one breechblock and two barrels
Dual cannons use normal shells and do not require additional propellant
Mechanical arms can be used for automatic loading, and no casing extraction is required. A mechanical arm loads only one shell at a time, and it has a cooldown after loading
Usually, one single depot is enough to supply ammunition to the cannon
Dual Cannon System
Dual cannons come in different calibers. Thin cannons generally have a higher rate of fire but lower damage
Wide cannons usually offer a balance between damage and rate of fire
Large cannons have higher damage, but a slower rate of fire
Single-barrel cannons are dual cannons with only one barrel, but they have a slightly faster rate of fire
Cannons in this system come in various materials, with differences in rate of fire, damage, accuracy, and other properties
All cannons in this system use normal shells
Combat Commands
The dual cannon system can use combat commands. These items temporarily improve cannon performance, but require a cooldown after use
Right-click the cannon mount with a combat command item to bind its position
Then place it into a Command Deployer and provide a redstone signal to activate it. Rebinding is not required when switching commands
Magazine Breech
Replace the quickfiring breech with a magazine breech and assemble it to turn the cannon into a magazine cannon
A magazine allows the cannon to fire multiple shells in a short time, but increases the total loading time
Each magazine allows the cannon to carry three additional reserve shells
Mechanical arm auto-loading is required to load shells into the magazine
cbcmoreshells.ponder.projectile_rack/pro: Projectile racks are used to carry drop-launched munitions. They must be assembled on a cannon mount, and require at least one latch and two body sections
After assembly, right-click the latch to open it, then right-click with a bomb in hand to load it
Projectile racks can carry and launch bombs, rockets, and other munitions. Different munition types have their own features
Note that torpedoes loaded on projectile racks are different from those launched from torpedo tubes
Projectile racks can also be loaded automatically using mechanical arms
cbcmoreshells.ponder.ammo_rack/ammo_rack: Ammo racks are used to store munition and supply loading for cannons
Mechanical arms can take munition directly from ammo racks
Right-click an ammo rack slot while holding munition to insert it
Right-click a slot with an empty hand to take munition out
Ammo racks can filter munition. Provide a redstone signal to switch the filtered ammo type
